description: Sanitizer crash triage: four AddressSanitizer / UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer reports (out-of-bounds read, out-of-bounds write, signed integer overflow, null pointer dereference) from a CI corpus job are stored in reports/. Name the CWE, the root cause function and the file for each in report/triage.md as `crash = crash-N | CWE-n | <function> | <file>` lines and fix the four defects; check.py hashes the lines against the reviewed triage and runs `make check` (g++ -std=c++17 -fsanitize=address,undefined) on the crashing and the normal inputs. Needs g++ and make on PATH (g++ is only reached through make, which is auto-approved).

criteria: The four report lines name CWE-125 in line_length (src/lines.cpp), CWE-787 in upcase (src/format.cpp), CWE-190 in weighted_total (src/stats.cpp) and CWE-476 in render (src/report.cpp), each backed by a short explanation of the root cause.

The four defects are fixed in src/ without changing behaviour for valid input; make check passes all six cases under the sanitizers and the Makefile, the tests, the reports and the gate are untouched.
